environment.description: Same Django REST API on EC2 in VPC subnet-0e4f5a6b. Instance profile 'IntegrationServiceRole-Gated' with identical S3 permissions. IMDSv1 enabled (HttpTokens: optional). Security group sg-0def456 allows outbound 0.0.0.0/0 on 80/443. S3 traffic routes through VPC endpoint vpce-0x8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b (Gateway type, route table associated). The VPC endpoint has a resource policy with Condition block: {"StringEquals": {"aws:sourceVpce": "vpce-0x8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b"}} on the bucket policy side, and the endpoint policy restricts PutObject to keys matching 'artifacts/validated/*' prefix only. Additionally, a separate interface endpoint for EC2 metadata (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ec2) exists but the subnet's route table has a blackhole route for 169.254.169.254/32 added via a custom network ACL entry (NACL rule 50: DENY ALL traffic to 169.254.169.254/32 on ephemeral ports, rule 51: DENY ALL traffic to 169.254.169.254/32 on port 80). Note: the NACL is stateless so both inbound response and outbound request rules apply.

config.vpc_endpoint_policy: Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::internal-integration-artifacts-prod/*, Allow s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::internal-integration-artifacts-prod/artifacts/validated/*
